title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-02-14
source: source: aud cassette master taped by Jim Cooper; hitachi trq-222 deck nak bx-300 > benchmark adc1 > adobe audition cs6 > tlh flac; transferred & seeded by Rob Berger

ai_review.summary: Dreamy historic recording captures a stellar 1970 set with Dark Hollow, Black Peter, Katie Mae and an impressive Dark Star, though the setlist appears disputed.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about the performance – highlighting powerful renditions of Dark Hollow, Black Peter, Katie Mae and a standout Dark Star – and praise the drummers for their energy. The audio is described as an echo from the past, giving it a nostalgic, slightly lo‑fi character, while one listener notes that the documented setlist does not match other known copies of the Feb 14 1970 show.

ai_rating.rationale: Two highly positive reviews emphasize excellent musical performance and a pleasing, historic‑sounding recording; a third note about setlist mismatch tempers the overall enthusiasm.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as an echo from the past – dreamy and nostalgic, with no major complaints about clarity or balance.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Setlist reported as not matching other copies of the 14 Feb 1970 show, causing some confusion about song order.

band_member_comments.Drums: Drummers noted as particularly impressive in this performance.
